title: Find Highest and Lowest Score per Exam
learning_objective: Learn how to calculate exam-level score boundaries.

tutorial.explanation: To find top and bottom performers, first compute the highest and lowest score inside each exam group.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT exam_id, MIN(score) AS lowest_score, MAX(score) AS highest_score FROM exams GROUP BY exam_id;
tutorial.mental_model: Each exam_id is a group. MIN and MAX summarize the score range inside that exam.

guided_example.prompt: Return the lowest and highest score for each exam.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT exam_id, MIN(score) AS lowest_score, MAX(score) AS highest_score FROM exams GROUP BY exam_id;
guided_example.explanation: GROUP BY creates one row per exam, then MIN and MAX find the boundary scores.

practice.prompt: Return exam_id and average score for each exam.
practice.expected_query: SELECT exam_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score FROM exams GROUP BY exam_id;
